question: In the RSC Advances study of biochar loading in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids for CO2 adsorption, which adsorbent in the paper's comparison table of MOF/biochar CO2 adsorbents has the highest CO2 uptake, and with which isotherm model?
rendered: BC-10 has the highest CO2 uptake of 1.77 mmol g−1 at 298 K and 1 bar, corresponding to approximately 52% and 29% enhancements relative to BC-0 and BC-20, respectively. The Freundlich isotherm model provided a better statistical description than the Langmuir isotherm model for BC-10.
